apoiar.frase: Ekfrase is free and open. Donations cover hosting and development.
erro.rede: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
erro.servidor: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again shortly.
erro.sessao: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
tema.explicacao: The button at the top switches between light and dark. Here you can also let the screen follow your device (dark when your phone or computer is in dark mode).
passeio.titulo: Game mode: walk around the Ekfrase castle
rodape.livre: Free software (MPL-2.0). Made by Alcy Filho.
conta.senha_nova.botao: Save the new password and sign in
conta.entrar.link: I already have an account: sign in
conta.esqueci.explicacao: Type your account's email. We will send you a link to create a new password.
conta.esqueci.enviado: Done. If this email has an account, the link arrives in a few minutes (check your spam too). It is valid for 60 minutes.
conta.erro.email: This email doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
conta.erro.senha_curta: The password needs at least 8 characters.
conta.erro.email_usado: There is already an account with this email. Sign in with it (or use "I forgot my password").
conta.erro.bloqueado: Too many attempts. Wait {minutos} minutes and try again.
conta.erro.email_desligado: Sending emails is not turned on on this site yet.
conta.erro.codigo_invalido: This link is no longer valid (over 60 minutes old or already used). Ask for another one.
conta.erro.rede: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
feedback.botao: Send feedback: a problem or an idea
feedback.exemplo.erro: E.g.: I tapped Save on my phone and the button disappeared. It should have saved the world.
feedback.exemplo.ideia: E.g.: It would be nice to add rivers to the map.
feedback.print.enviar: Send the screenshot of this screen
feedback.print.aviso: It is only sent if you tick it. Check first that nothing you don't want to show appears in it.
feedback.print.falhou: Couldn't take a screenshot of this screen. If you like, attach one of your own below.
feedback.anexos.ajuda: Up to {n} images: your own screenshots, a photo of the problem…
feedback.contato.ajuda: Only if you want an answer. Signed-in people don't need it.
feedback.vai_junto: The address of this screen, the type of device and the window size go along. None of your files.
feedback.restam.one: You can send 1 more this hour.
feedback.restam.other: You can send {count} more this hour.
feedback.obrigado: Thank you! Feedback {numero} arrived. It will be read carefully.
feedback.erro.tipo: One of the images is not PNG, JPEG or WebP.
feedback.erro.grande: The images are bigger than the server accepts. Send fewer or smaller ones.
feedback.erro.email: This email doesn't look right. Check it, or leave it blank.
feedback.erro.rede: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
feedback.erro.limite: You've sent the maximum for this hour. You can send again at {hora}.
entrada.online.texto: Use it in the browser, on any device. You need to sign in with your Ekfrase account: what you save stays in the cloud and shows up everywhere.
entrada.computador.texto: The app for Windows and Linux: works offline and keeps everything on your computer.
entrada.arquivos.texto: Export a file to keep or take elsewhere, and import it whenever you like: online and in the desktop app.
conta.entrar.ekfrase: Sign in to your Ekfrase account
conta.ekfrase.explicacao: Walking around the castle, downloading the apps and reading the books don't need an account. With an Ekfrase account you customise your character and your photo, keep books in your inventory (with notes and where you stopped) and use the same account in every app.

entrada.pendrive.texto: A USB stick that boots a computer straight into the app, with nothing else of the system: write on any machine and take it all with you.
entrada.casa.texto: Open {nome} and pick up where you left off.
feedback.guardado: No internet right now: your feedback was saved on this device and will be sent automatically when the internet is back.
